aggregation: task families reported separately; no scalar aggregate score is used for selection
evaluation_window: all post-issue samples through case end

setpoint.success: after reference issue, position error <=0.05 m, cutter orientation error <=5 deg, and tip speed <=0.10 m/s continuously for 1.0 s
setpoint.acquisition: elapsed seconds from reference issue to first successful 1.0 s window; null on failure

smooth_trajectory.success: safe case with full-window tip RMSE <=0.20 m, P95 error <=0.40 m, orientation RMSE <=8 deg, velocity RMSE <=0.30 m/s, and endpoint error <=0.10 m
smooth_trajectory.engineering_rationale: The 0.05 m setpoint tolerance is inherited unchanged. Smooth paths span the same <=2 m mission envelope but require continuous tracking, so the full-window tolerance is four times the terminal precision, P95 is limited to twice that value, and the endpoint returns to twice the setpoint tolerance; orientation remains close to the cutter's 5 deg terminal precision while allowing transient motion. These values are frozen before any P2-R1 performance.

catastrophic: any safety-v2 violation, non-finite output, or final tip error >2.0 m
